notes:
K8Secret 0.6.2 — the tour points at what it is talking about.

The ⌘K stop had no rectangle of its own: the toolbar hosts that pill outside SwiftUI's view tree, so the spotlight stayed wherever the previous stop had left it and the namespace menu lit up while the card explained search. AppKit can measure toolbar items — it is how the namespace menu already hangs from its pill — so the tour is handed those rectangles too. The ⌘K stop now lights the search pill itself, with its card beneath it by the same rule every other stop follows, and a stop with nothing to point at clears the spotlight instead of inheriting the last one.
